hackathons.prize: 总奖金 $1,500：第一名 $600、第二名 $500、第三名 $400；前三名另各得一把 Monad 定制机械键盘
hackathons.summary: OpenBuild 发布、Monad Foundation 为规则与版权方的纯线下一日黑客松，2026 年 11 月 21 日（周六）09:00–21:00 在广州举行，具体场馆报名成功后才公布。主题是在高性能并行 EVM Layer 1 公链 Monad 上构建 dApp 原型、用 Testnet 实验：上午 Monad 101 工作坊，中午组队，12:00–18:30 开发，当天 18:30 提交截止，19:00 Demo 展示，获奖者由现场观众投票选出。单人或组队，每队最多 3 人，有报名筛选，面向 Web2/Web3 开发者；费用与报名截止官方未公布，目前报名进行中。组队、提交与评选在 MOJO 官方活动页（报名后解锁）：https://mojo.devnads.com/events/18
hackathons.summary_en: A one-day, fully in-person hackathon published by OpenBuild, with rules and IP held by the Monad Foundation, held in Guangzhou on Saturday, Nov 21, 2026, 09:00-21:00; the exact venue is revealed only after a successful application. The theme is building dApp prototypes on Monad, a high-performance parallel-EVM Layer 1, experimenting on testnet: a Monad 101 workshop in the morning, team formation at noon, building from 12:00 to 18:30, submissions closing at 18:30 the same day, demos at 19:00, and winners chosen by on-site audience vote. Solo entries or teams of up to 3; applications are screened; open to Web2 and Web3 developers. The organizer has not published a fee or a registration deadline; registration is currently open. Team formation, submissions and judging run on the official MOJO event page (unlocked after registration): https://mojo.devnads.com/events/18
hackathons.prize_en: $1,500 total: $600 for 1st place, $500 for 2nd, $400 for 3rd; the top three also each receive a custom Monad mechanical keyboard

hackathons.title: Agent ID Hackathon
hackathons.prize: 60,000 USDC（生态增长奖 29,000 + 创新奖 29,000 + 社区推广奖 2,000；获奖项目另得两位数 Agent ID 领取资格）
hackathons.summary: 币安钱包与 BNB Chain 联合举办：围绕 Agent ID（Agentic Wallet 的链上身份 name.ai，每人限领一个、不可转让）构建 dApp。项目须部署在 BNB Chain、合约在 BscScan 开源验证，并把 Agent ID 真实集成进产品（如访问控制、支付、身份）。奖池 60,000 USDC：生态增长奖 29,000 按链上交互数据排名（交互的 Agent ID 地址数、交易量）；创新奖 29,000 由评委打分（Agent ID 集成深度 30%、实用性 25%、完成度 25%、创新 20%），门槛为产品已上线且提交期内至少 30 个 Agent ID 地址与合约交互；另有社区推广奖 2,000。两类奖各取前 10，获奖项目另得两位数 Agent ID 领取资格。无需报名，提交期内提交项目信息即可；提交期 2026-11-18 08:00 UTC 至 12-09 08:00 UTC。
hackathons.summary_en: Hosted by Binance Wallet and BNB Chain: build dApps around Agent ID, the on-chain identity (name.ai) of an Agentic Wallet (one per user, non-transferable). Projects must deploy on BNB Chain, verify and open-source contracts on BscScan, and genuinely integrate Agent ID into the product (e.g. access control, payments, identity). The 60,000 USDC pool splits into 29,000 USDC in ecosystem growth awards ranked by on-chain interaction data (number of interacting Agent ID addresses, transaction volume) and 29,000 USDC in innovation awards scored by judges (Agent ID integration depth 30%, practicality 25%, completion 25%, innovation 20%), which require a live product and at least 30 Agent ID addresses interacting with the contracts during the submission period; plus a 2,000 USDC community promotion award. Each category takes a top 10, and winning projects also receive a two-digit Agent ID claim spot. No registration needed; submit project details during the submission period, 2026-11-18 08:00 UTC to 2026-12-09 08:00 UTC.
hackathons.title_en: Agent ID Hackathon: Build dApps Around Agent ID
hackathons.summary_tw: 幣安錢包與 BNB Chain 聯合舉辦：圍繞 Agent ID（Agentic Wallet 的鏈上身份 name.ai，每人限領一個、不可轉讓）構建 dApp。項目須部署在 BNB Chain、合約在 BscScan 開源驗證，並把 Agent ID 真實集成進產品（如訪問控制、支付、身份）。獎池 60,000 USDC：生態增長獎 29,000 按鏈上交互數據排名（交互的 Agent ID 地址數、交易量）；創新獎 29,000 由評委打分（Agent ID 集成深度 30%、實用性 25%、完成度 25%、創新 20%），門檻為產品已上線且提交期內至少 30 個 Agent ID 地址與合約交互；另有社區推廣獎 2,000。兩類獎各取前 10，獲獎項目另得兩位數 Agent ID 領取資格。無需報名，提交期內提交項目信息即可；提交期 2026-11-18 08:00 UTC 至 12-09 08:00 UTC。
hackathons.prize_en: 60,000 USDC (29,000 ecosystem growth + 29,000 innovation + 2,000 community promotion; winning projects also get a two-digit Agent ID claim spot)
